overrides.why: src/gs-shell.ui declares <property name="visible">False</property> on the GsShell template, because the shell is presented programmatically once the application has finished loading rather than shown by the builder. Imported faithfully the window renders nothing at all, so a designer screen must show it.
Native probe (presets-src/software.probe.json): once the first frame settles the shell's outer stack shows the main surface, not the initial loading page — the loading page is a startup transient.
Native probe: the can-unfold=false navigation leaflet shows its main page; the details surface is unmapped until an app is opened.
Native probe: the inner navigation leaflet shows its main page; the category/extras sub-surface is unmapped at startup.
Native probe: the overview page is the mapped main page in --mode=overview; installed/search/updates pages are unmapped siblings in the same stack.
